text:
clara.marketing: Hey folks 1 the new launch blog draft is in Google (sharing in thread). Main asks: pick a hero variant, surface a 1-line benchmark under hero, finalize webinar CTA + three registration tiers, and confirm UTMs + lead tag for HubSpot. Quick passes appreciated.

devin.prod: Quick skim 1 love the narrative. Two hero variants in the doc: A) "Predictable LLM serving that can reduce per-token cost by up to ~40%" B) "Production LLM serving: lower latency, predictable cost." Leaning A but legal/timebox needed.

anika.content: I prefer A for attention. Suggest adding a tiny stat card under hero: "Benchmark snapshot: up to ~40% lower per-token cost vs baseline single-instance serving*" then footnote link. Also propose a short subhead: "Real app traces, production configs."

jorge.growth: UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_launch_may. Add hidden field "launch_interest" for form and dropdown: [Attend live, Watch recording, Pilot/case-study]. Also add lead tag 'launch_may' so Sales can route. I can wire HubSpot mapping after lock.

sophie.legal: Quickpass: Variant A ok if we use "can reduce" and keep "up to". Footnote required: "*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results vary by model, sequence length, batch size, and config. See appendix for methodology and run dates." Add short privacy line near form: "By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; data stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy." No competitor names without public citations.

lucas.design: I'll make a compact stat card under the hero and two CTA button styles (primary & ghost). Need final CTA text and 2-line "what you'll learn" for the card. Also: we should A/B test hero A vs B in the blog header. Can the copy team prepare both and we wire a simple experiment?

anika.content: Good call on A/B. I'll leave both hero lines and variations of the subhead in the doc. CTA copy proposal: "Register: Live launch walkthrough + cost playbook".
What you'll learn:
- Unit-cost levers and benchmark context
- Deployment checklist for Dedicated & Private
- Live demo + Q&A (product team)

devin.prod: Appendix checklist for benchmark: model family, sequence lengths, batch sizes, hardware, Optimize toggles (caching, quantization), and date-run. That will keep legal/sales happy.

sophie.legal: Approved with footnote + privacy line. Please ensure "can reduce" phrasing and footnote link to appendix.

jorge.growth: +1 on UTMs and fields. I'll create HubSpot field mapping and a routing rule for tag 'launch_may'. Also recommend mapping registration tiers to lifecycle stage.

lucas.design: Approved on layout; I'll deliver hero card + CTA assets by tomorrow EOD. Adding a small 'register' sticky on mobile.

publish-bot: Heads-up: publish window opens in 48h. Final approvals required before 4pm PT to hit the slot.

clara.marketing: Thanks everyone ":tada:" I'll lock the copy at 4pm PT if all approved and send the A/B hero variants to Lucas. Devin/Anika/Sophie/Jorge 1 please ping if you want a final sweep before lock.
